info.title: Cinema Ordering API
info.description: QBusto backend API. Operational probes (/health, /ready, /version) live at the root; all business endpoints live under /api.

bearerAuth.description: Access token issued by the authentication endpoint.

Pagination.description: Present in `meta` on paginated list responses.

permissions.description: Present only when the user was loaded with permissions.

code.description: Short identifier used in QR ordering URLs. Unique system-wide.

chainId.description: Copied from the product's category; never accepted from a request.

cinemaProductId.description: The cinema/product link this window applies to.

ProductPricing.description: Decimal columns are returned as strings to preserve exact scale. Discount amounts are only meaningful when discountType is set.

sequence.description: Display order. Unique within a cinema.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed or expired access token

Forbidden.description: Authenticated, but not permitted to perform this action

get.description: Paginated. Non-owners see only users in their own chain. Requires the Users module read permission.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Partial match against username, first name or last name.

post.description: The user and their permission rows are written in a single transaction. `chainId` is honoured only for owners; every other role creates within their own chain. Requires the Users module edit permission.

403.description: Missing the Users edit permission, or an attempt to assign a role above your own or grant a permission you do not hold.

409.description: Username already taken, or the cinema belongs to another chain

get.summary: Get a user with their permissions

put.description: Send `permissions` to replace the user's permission set entirely; omit it to leave permissions untouched. The update and the permission replacement share one transaction. `chainId` cannot be changed, and passwords are changed only through /api/auth/change-password.

403.description: Missing the Users edit permission, an attempt to change your own role, to assign a role above your own, or to grant a permission you do not hold.

409.description: Username taken, the cinema belongs to another chain, or an attempt to deactivate your own account.

delete.description: Sets `is_active` to false. The row is never removed - orders, status logs and audit columns reference it. Permission rows are kept so reactivating restores previous access. Idempotent. Requires the Users module delete permission.

409.description: You cannot deactivate your own account

get.description: Paginated. Non-owners see only screens whose cinema is in their own chain. Requires the Settings module read permission.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Partial match against the screen name.

parameters.name: cinemaId
parameters.description: Narrows within the actor's chain; a cinema outside it simply matches nothing.

post.description: The referenced cinema must exist, be in the actor's chain, and be active. Screen names are unique within a cinema, counting deactivated screens. Requires the Settings module edit permission.

404.description: The referenced cinema does not exist, or is in another chain

409.description: A screen with this name already exists in this cinema, or the cinema is deactivated

put.description: `cinemaId` cannot be changed: orders reference a screen, so moving one between cinemas would rewrite the history of those orders.

409.description: A screen with this name already exists in this cinema

delete.description: Sets `is_active` to false. The row is never removed - orders and POS mappings reference it. Idempotent. Requires the Settings module delete permission.

get.description: Paginated. Non-owners see only products in their own chain. Requires the Products module read permission.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Partial match against the product name.

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Owners only; ignored for every other role.

parameters.name: addonParentId
parameters.description: List the add-ons attached to one product.

post.description: `chainId` is not accepted: a product belongs to the chain of its category, and the service copies it from there so the two can never disagree. Product names are unique within a category, counting deactivated products. Requires the Products module edit permission.

addonParentId.description: The product this add-on attaches to. Must be in the same chain and must not itself be an add-on.

400.description: Validation failed, or the add-on parent is itself an add-on

404.description: The referenced category or add-on parent does not exist

409.description: A product with this name already exists in the category

put.description: A product may be re-filed under another category, but only one inside the same chain.

409.description: The name is taken in the target category, or the target category belongs to a different chain

delete.description: Sets `is_active` to false. The row is never removed - order items, pricing and POS mappings all reference it. Idempotent. Requires the Products module delete permission.

get.description: Paginated. Non-owners see only pricing for cinemas in their own chain. Requires the Pricing module read permission.

post.description: The cinema and the product must belong to the same chain. (cinemaId, productId, dayOfWeek) is unique. Discount amounts require `discountType` to be set, and are capped at 100 when it is `P`. Requires the Pricing module edit permission.

discountType.description: P = percentage, F = flat amount. Governs every discount below.

400.description: Validation failed, a percentage exceeded 100, or a discount amount was supplied without a discountType

404.description: The referenced cinema or product does not exist, or is in another chain

409.description: A price already exists for this cinema, product and day, or the cinema and product belong to different chains

put.description: `cinemaId`, `productId` and `dayOfWeek` cannot be changed: together they are the natural key, so changing one identifies a different row rather than editing this one.

400.description: Validation failed, or the result would leave a discount amount without a discountType

delete.description: Sets `is_active` to false. The row is never removed - historical orders are priced from it. Idempotent. Requires the Pricing module delete permission.

get.description: Reports that the process is running. Does not touch the database, so it stays 200 during a database outage - use /ready to gate traffic.
Verifies database connectivity, that no migrations are pending, and that required seed data is present. Returns 503 when any check fails.

200.description: Service is ready to accept traffic

get.description: Paginated. Non-owners see only cinemas in their own chain. Requires the Settings module read permission.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Partial match against name, code or city.

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Owners only; ignored for every other role, which is already scoped to one chain.

post.description: `chainId` is honoured only for owners; every other role creates within their own chain. The referenced chain must exist and be active. `code` appears in QR ordering URLs, is stored upper case, and is unique across the whole system. Requires the Settings module edit permission.

404.description: The referenced chain does not exist

409.description: A cinema with this code already exists, or the chain is deactivated

put.description: `chainId` cannot be changed: moving a cinema between chains would carry its screens, orders and pricing across a tenant boundary.

409.description: A cinema with this code already exists

delete.description: Sets `is_active` to false. The row is never removed - screens, orders and pricing all reference it. Idempotent. Requires the Settings module delete permission.

get.description: Paginated. Non-owners see only their own chain. Requires the Settings module read permission.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Partial match against the chain name.

post.description: Owners only. Every other role is pinned to their own chain by tenant scope, so a chain they created would be unreadable to them. Also requires the Settings module edit permission.

403.description: Missing the Settings edit permission, or not an owner

409.description: A chain with this name already exists
A chain with this name already exists

delete.description: Sets `is_active` to false. The row is never removed - cinemas, users, categories and products all reference it. Idempotent. Requires the Settings module delete permission.

get.description: Paginated. Non-owners see only categories in their own chain. Requires the Categories module read permission.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Partial match against the category name.

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Owners only; ignored for every other role, which is already scoped to one chain.

post.description: `chainId` is honoured only for owners; every other role creates within their own chain. Category names are unique within a chain, counting deactivated categories. Requires the Categories module edit permission.

404.description: The referenced chain does not exist

409.description: A category with this name already exists in the chain

put.description: `chainId` cannot be changed: moving a category between chains would drag its products across a tenant boundary.

409.description: A category with this name already exists in the chain

delete.description: Sets `is_active` to false. The row is never removed - products and cinema_categories reference it. Products under the category are left untouched; this is not a cascade. Idempotent. Requires the Categories module delete permission.

get.description: Paginated, ordered by `sequence` by default - the order they are displayed in. Non-owners see only banners for cinemas in their own chain. Requires the Banners module read permission.

post.description: One row carries one image, so a cinema shows several banners by holding several rows. `sequence` is unique within a cinema and decides the display order. The cinema must be active. `endDate` may not fall before `startDate`. Requires the Banners module edit permission.

400.description: Validation failed, or endDate falls before startDate

404.description: The referenced cinema does not exist, or is in another chain

409.description: A banner with this sequence already exists in the cinema, or the cinema is deactivated

put.description: `cinemaId` cannot be changed: moving a banner would sidestep the target cinema's sequence rule. Supplying only one end of the date window is still checked against the stored value of the other.

400.description: Validation failed, or the resulting date window runs backwards

409.description: A banner with this sequence already exists in the cinema

delete.description: Sets `is_active` to false. The row stays, so its sequence stays reserved and the banner can be brought back. Idempotent. Requires the Banners module delete permission.

get.description: Paginated. Non-owners see only windows whose cinema is in their own chain. Requires the Products module read permission.

post.description: Attaches to a cinema_product, so the window applies to one product at one cinema. `startTime` must be earlier than `endTime`, and the window may not overlap another for the same cinema_product. A window on day 0 (every day) is checked against every other day. Requires the Products module edit permission.

400.description: Validation failed, or endTime is not later than startTime

404.description: The referenced cinema product does not exist, or is in another chain

409.description: The window overlaps an existing one

put.description: The whole range is required: half a range has no meaning, and comparing one new time against one stored time is not a check worth trusting. `cinemaProductId` cannot be changed.

409.description: The window overlaps an existing one

delete.description: A hard delete. product_availability_hours has no `is_active` column and nothing references a window, so the row is removed outright - unlike every other module in this phase. Requires the Products module delete permission.

200.description: Availability window deleted, returned as it last existed

post.summary: Exchange credentials for an access token
post.description: Returns a signed JWT plus the user's profile and permissions. The token carries only the user id and role - permissions are reloaded from the database on every request, so a revoked permission takes effect at once.

403.description: Credentials are correct but the account is deactivated

post.description: JWT authentication is stateless, so this records the event and returns success. Clients should discard their stored token. There is no token blacklist; use a short token lifetime to bound exposure.

get.summary: Profile, role and permissions of the authenticated user

post.description: Requires the current password. Only ever changes the authenticated user's own password - there is no administrative reset endpoint.

401.description: Missing token, or the current password is incorrect

get.description: Confirms the API is mounted and reachable.
